description.value: Bonta is an authentically Italian restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, run by an owner with over 20 years of multiregional Italian cuisine experience. The kitchen leans on generational recipes and locally sourced artisanal ingredients, spanning antipasti, house-made pasta, pizza, and mains such as saffron lamb shank with house gnocchi. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and online ordering is supported.
